objective: Retry the unchanged V8 R1-R3 in-memory component diagnostic after the only allowed ModuleList index-type repair.

repair.scope: Change model.task_cakes[str(route)] to model.task_cakes[route] and add one ModuleList regression test.

variants.R0: sealed B1 checkpoint and existing unmodified evaluation
variants.R1: same B1 checkpoint with all six output cakes bypassed in memory
variants.R2: same B1 checkpoint with route embedding bypassed in memory
variants.R3: same B1 checkpoint with output cakes and route embedding bypassed in memory

evaluation.decoding: identical deterministic greedy V6 development decoding

interpretation.R1: Dependence on trained output cakes after holding the sequence bridge and inferred route fixed.
interpretation.R2: Dependence on the learned route embedding after holding shared sequence adapters and output cakes fixed.
interpretation.R3: Residual behavior carried by shared prompt projection and pre-block sequence adapters after removing both route-specific mechanisms.
interpretation.coadaptation_caveat: A post-training bypass can establish component dependence but cannot predict the exact result of retraining without that component.
interpretation.successor_rule: Use the diagnostic only to choose the component set for one separately preregistered train-from-initialization successor. Do not select a checkpoint, route, threshold, data budget, rank, loss, or duration from these outputs.

stop_rule: Run R1, R2, and R3 once on the full development matrix. Do not access final data, persist an ablated checkpoint, force individual routes, or turn an ablation into a candidate. Preserve every output and issue one descriptive decision.
claim_boundary: This is a mechanistic diagnostic, not training, transfer certification, candidate promotion, evidence of semantic-routing value, or permission to open Phase 4.
